procedure: read-only parse of each held cell's logs/proxy_*.jsonl, server_telemetry.jsonl (baseline, generation_start, final monotonic snapshots; history_kv_lifecycle) and server.log decode lines; no model, harness, or remote mutation
question: are the 600 s 'upstream 0: timed out' requests slow decode or runaway generation?
answer: neither runaway nor steady-state decode: every timed-out generation appended a ~31.7k-token BFCL long-context tool observation, spent 377-596 s in chunked prefill on the reference-attention route, and had decoded only 0-126 tokens at abort (cap 4096)

ok_requests.slowest_twelve: 11 of 12: new turn ~31.7k tokens, prefill 406-490 s, 46-470 completion tokens at 6.5-7.0 tok/s; 1 of 12: 644-token turn, length-capped 4096-token answer in 509 s at 8.0 tok/s

bfcl_long_context__history_kv_pyramidkv_.recorded_as_37_timeouts: 4 generation timeouts plus 33 episode-setup /flush_cache timeouts; the 38th ledger gap is the cleanup failure

unabortable_prefill.chunked_prefill: 512-token chunks every 18 s at 35.5k growing to 38 s at 51.9k resident tokens
unabortable_prefill.proxy: 600 s TimeoutError, then POST /abort_request -> 504 request_status=cleanup_timeout after 60 s
unabortable_prefill.engine: session closed but the request kept prefilling; server_telemetry duration 2381.4 s, error PERSISTENT_HISTORY_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE
unabortable_prefill.consequence: 33 consecutive episodes failed setup (/flush_cache timed out waiting for idle, 55 s each) from 23:54:22 to 00:21:38Z; those tasks never ran

conclusions: Not runaway generation: at abort every timed-out request had decoded 0-126 tokens against a 4096 cap.
The deadline is consumed by prefill of the appended ~31.7k-token long-context observation (377-596 s), followed by ~6-7.5 tok/s decode at 34-46k context.

commitkv_b768/agentkv_b768: observed worst prefill 559 s plus a 4096-token answer at 6 tok/s is about 1.24k s, so 1800 s covers every observed request class; this is a projection from observed rates, not a measured run.
pyramidkv_r25: one request needed at least 2381 s of prefill alone (67k-token fill), so 1800 s is not shown sufficient; later turns of that conversation start from a larger resident history.

On engine e2b3b7ec0, an abort during reference-attention chunked prefill is not honoured (504 cleanup_timeout, request continues). Any deadline that fires inside such a prefill can wedge the server and void later tasks. This is an engine lifecycle limitation, reported rather than changed here.

covers: runner prepare --generation-timeout 1800 freezes the value and adds '--generation-timeout 1800.0' only to persistent history-KV cells; every other command is byte-identical to the default root
run.py parses the prepared bfcl_long commitkv/agentkv (2048, b768) and pyramidkv_r25 commands to 1800.0 (default 600.0)
the BFCL client read deadline is request_timeout + 90 s (1890 s) with an 8 s connect deadline
run.py start_proxy -> real proxy process -> fake engine: a 1 s deadline returns 502 'upstream 0: timed out' after one abort_request, a 6 s deadline returns 200
wiring_validation.cuda_validation: not run; requires a GPU allocated by the patrol session

result_scope: diagnosis of existing held runs; no new model execution
